translationRepairs: Xiaoyu urged him to seek advancement; He Shikai deeply hated this, and therefore memorialized to remove Xiaoyu as Administrator of Zhangwu Commandery and to send Yuanliang and the others out as well.

Xiaoyu urged him to seek advancement; He Shikai deeply hated this, and therefore memorialized to appoint Xiaoyu as Administrator of Zhangwu Commandery and to send Yuanliang and the others out as well.

s0072 has 奏除孝裕為章武郡守: 除…為 is the standard appointment formula, not removal. The original literal reverses that sense; 'appoint … as Administrator of Zhangwu Commandery' matches the Chinese and the sidelining of 元亮等皆出.
